message: Hi, I'm a student with a information security certification background. My overall academic average is 73.9% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in hacking and testing. Honestly I'm not fully sure what I want to become — something in tech. My family can afford at most about USD 6000 per year. I live in Pune. I cannot leave my city. Getting a good job after graduation matters more to me than anything else.
explanation:
This program directly aligns with your background in information security and your interest in hacking/testing. It is located in Pune, has a low tuition cost ($1450), and offers a relevant career path.

This MTech Cyber Security program is highly specialized for your interests in hacking and testing. It has the lowest tuition cost ($650) among security options and meets all your constraints (Pune location, low cost).

While focused on QA testing, this program is a strong fit because quality assurance often involves penetration testing and security validation. It has the highest placement rate (91%) among all Pune options, which addresses your priority of job prospects.

This MTech Computer Networks program offers a strong technical foundation in networking and software engineering. It has the highest median starting salary ($15192) listed, making it excellent for job prospects while remaining within your budget.

This MSc Software Engineering program provides a broad technical skillset that can be adapted to security roles. It is affordable ($1450), located in Pune, and has a decent placement rate (84%), offering good job stability.
